title: The Man Who Made Ford Beat Ferrari
description:
In nineteen sixty-six, Ford finally beat Ferrari at Le Mans, the most famous endurance race in the world. The man most responsible for that win was not a Ford executive. He was a Texan who had once gone bankrupt raising chickens, a man with a bad heart who had been forced out of the driver's seat. His name was Carroll Shelby. Here is the twist. Shelby had already won Le Mans himself, years earlier, in a British car. And when his heart forced him to stop driving, he became something even more dangerous to Ferrari. A builder. This is the insane story behind the Ford GT, told through the man who made it a legend.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
